definitions: A senior female member of staff in a boarding school or other residential institution, responsible for the welfare of students or residents.
A woman in charge of the nursing and domestic arrangements of a hospital.
A married woman, especially a dignified, staid, or middle-aged one.
examples: The matron comforted the homesick child.
She was promoted to matron of the hospital.
The matron of the family presided over dinner.
